notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Hey guys! 

It feels great to finally have the Steam community experiencing our game and giving us feedback! We have taken note of some minor bugs and requests and will have a patch out shortly to fix up some stuff and add some requested features!

some stuff we noted:
- New navigation methods, other than teleporting
- Even more game modes
- Customizable options, such as weapon grip angle
- Some experienced loading times in the elevator

[h1]We are working on a huge update for you guys right now with tons of new content! New levels to play, new weapons, an item shop, and so much more![/h1]

Thanks for all the support! 

You guys are awesome! <3

Ben

notes.title: We're so excited for release!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We are super excited to bring you this awesome project we have been creating! The game is currently under review by steam, and will be released as soon as we get the green light! 

We've been working on Housekeeping for about 2.5 months now and are so excited to show it to the people for feedback! We have huge plans for this game and want the community to shape the final product. If you have any questions of comments, contact us! We would love to hear from you! 

This is our first time creating a Virtual Reality project and we want it to be one of the best experiences available, because we love VR just as much as you guys. Its the future of gaming and we want to be at the front of this awesome new gaming experience and bring you the best products we can.

Thanks for the support and stay tuned for more!

Get in touch with us, we'd love to hear what you think!

Ben <3
